originality.rationale: Arnold (2026) Section 6.1 already optimizes the equal-weight Bernoulli multiplier scalar norm, so the equal-weight two-point case is explicitly acknowledged as prior. The candidate is the general four-moment two-term asymptotic for all finite positive polynomial shift multipliers, with a parameter-dependent sign reversal. The inspected literature contains no implication covering that general statement, although a general analytic saddle-point theorem remains a priority risk.
residual_risks: A general stationary-point asymptotic theorem may imply the distribution-dependent second-order coefficient, even if not formulated for power-bounded operators.
